title: Setup Database
description:
Define the production PostgreSQL database setup so the application can persist user accounts and audit records reliably from day one.

## Means of Compliance
| # | Acceptance Criterion | MoC | Evidence |
|---|----------------------|-----|----------|
| 1 | Database is configured and accessible. | integ | tests/integration/test_database_bootstrap.py |
| 2 | Application can connect and run migrations successfully. | smoke | scripts/smoke/database-bootstrap.sh |
acceptance_criteria: Database is configured and accessible. Application can connect and run migrations successfully.

metadata.intent: Establish the foundational database layer for the application.
